newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, BCE dollar futures drop.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, BCE dollar futures drop.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished the Tuesday session of the interbank forex market firmer against the dollar on the back of a morning surge, dealers said.
The forint finished at 154.97 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155.50/55.
"The gains were due to a morning rally against the U.S. currency, followed by a slight correction," said Zsolt Tiliman of Citibank.
He added that afternoon trading was relatively quiet after very excited morning trade.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) dollar futures ended lower for all but one maturity while the sterling and lira dropped for one maturity each.
The yen also finished lower for one maturity, the Swiss franc ended mixed, the German mark rose for two and the Ecu rose for three maturities.
Most of the relatively high turnover of 9.81 billion forints was made up of Swiss franc contracts, followed by roughly equal amounts of lira and yen contracts.
